stratagem.name: RELENTLESS ASSAULT
stratagem.lore: Pressing mercilessly forward, these warriors place shots and blows perfectly, no matter their targets.
stratagem.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is selected to attack.
stratagem.effect: Your unit’s attacks have: ▪ [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle]. ▪ Or: [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

stratagem.name: TRANSHUMAN SWIFTNESS
stratagem.lore: Poised and aware of their foes’ every move, these warriors strike at the most tactically advantageous moment.
stratagem.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit has fought.
stratagem.target: One friendly TACTICUS unit that is within range of an objective and is eligible to fight.
stratagem.effect: Your unit has Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight.

stratagem.name: TACTICAL FOCUS
stratagem.lore: Even amidst the fiercest fighting, this squad retains sight of their assigned mission.
stratagem.when: Fight phase, when a friendly TACTICUS unit is selected to make a consolidation move.
stratagem.effect: When making that consolidation move, your unit can move up to D3+3".
